result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a visible UI string appears as an unlocalized translation key instead of the intended section title.

issues.description: The section heading displays the literal key 'home_feed.popular_title' rather than the localized title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing localized string for this key in the app's language files, or provide a fallback human-readable title so the heading renders correctly.
